subject: math
description: Find missing side lengths, angle measures, heights, and diagonal parts in parallelograms using their defining properties.
learningObjectives: Identify the defining properties of a parallelogram
Use opposite side and opposite angle relationships to solve for unknown measures
Use consecutive angle relationships to find missing angles
Use diagonal bisection to find missing segment lengths
Apply base-height reasoning to solve area and height problems
prerequisites: Identify parallel lines and angle relationships
Use supplementary angles that add to 180 degrees
Find area of rectangles using base times height
Read basic geometric diagrams and labels
